definition: A virtual interface is a logical connection that provides access to an AWS destination over Direct Connect.
MACsec protects traffic on a point-to-point Ethernet link with encryption and integrity checks.
A virtual private gateway provides edge routing for managed VPN and Direct Connect connections to a VPC.
A VPC is a logically isolated virtual network in AWS.
A VPN tunnel is an encrypted link carrying data between a customer network and AWS.
BGP exchanges routing information between AWS and remote network endpoints.
